comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus load washable blender parts while excluding the motor base.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires fine tool engagement and force-controlled rotary work; record identifies, grasps, nests, and arranges detachable blender components while avoiding an excluded component.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two energy-qualified safe stops; record requires the correct washable parts loaded in the designated receptacle and the motor base left out, with no loss or damage.
comparison.reason: Part classification and container loading do not test dynamic tuning. Missing numeric candidate response thresholds do not create plausible duplication.
